entities.summary: Catholic Church, a political institution in Colombia during Gran Colombia, Dissolution, and 19th-Century Conflicts (1831–1886). Grew from Bolívar dies in Santa Marta — December 17, 1830 and Congress of Cúcuta — Gran Colombia constitution, 1821. Led to the emergence of Liberal-Conservative Civil Wars and Panama secedes with U.S. backing — November 3, 1903.
